name: Log-space Exclusive Cumulative Sum for Transmittance
definition: A method to compute exclusive cumulative sums of transmittance (T) in log space to avoid underflow and enable efficient scatter-add operations for alpha compositing weights.
summary: Log-space Exclusive Cumulative Sum for Transmittance computes transmittance in logarithmic space to prevent numerical underflow and enable efficient parallel scatter-add operations for weight calculation.
